title: feat(import): keep the SolidCraft source face and name of each .sc facet
body:
## What changes

A `.sc` import now keeps the SolidCraft source face and its name for each facet of the model. This is the first sub-issue of #3915. The other sub-issues use the names: #4213 (face picks follow the names) and #4214 (MCP). Nothing reads the names in this PR, and the project file does not change. A user sees no change, except one new import note in a rare case (D2).

- **Kernel** (`crates/kernel/src/solidcraft/`, new `names.rs`):
  - The `.sc` reader reads the name of each record face of the final body from `cache/model.json`. The names are `model.names[n]`, where `n` is the final model body's `names` field.
  - It keeps `faces[i]`, and from `info[i]` the `verified` flag and the optional fifth item `former`. `info` with four items and with five items both read.
  - It reads names only from model cache format 10 (`NAMES_FORMAT`).
  - `SolidcraftImport` gets `names` (one entry for each record face, in record order) and `names_note`.
- **Geometry** (`crates/geometry/src/`, new `source_faces.rs`):
  - `SourceFaces` holds the names and one facet range for each run of a record face. The ranges come from `MachiningMesh::tri_face`.
  - `solidcraft::parse` returns the record beside the mesh, on native and on wasm.
  - A record whose ranges do not tile the facets is dropped with a note.
- **App** (`crates/app/src/`, new `source_faces.rs`):
  - A new component `schema::SourceFaces` holds the record on the model, in memory only. Code reads and writes it only through `source_faces::{of, set}`.
  - The record keeps the model revision and the facet count that it landed with. When other facets land (a repair, an update without a record), `of` gives `None`.
  - `ImportModel` lands the record. Undo and redo trade it.
  - `UpdateModel::with_source_faces` trades it on undo. An update that does not state it drops it. `RepairModel` drops it (`keeping_fidelity` does not keep it).
  - `DeleteEntity` puts it back on undo.
  - The window (`ui/src/state.rs`), the script and MCP import (`script/api.rs`) and the fixture re-import (`commands/import_fixture.rs`) pass it. Each is one builder call.

Decisions: `docs/decisions/4212-sc-face-names.md`.
- D1: names from model cache format 10 only.
- D2: the import never fails because of names. Names that do not fit give no names and one note ("Solidcraft: the face names were not read: ..."). A partial or shifted list is never kept.
- D3: the names are in memory only in this PR. The project file does not change.

No new dependency. No change to `project/*`, to a post, or to a toolpath.

## Maintainer questions on #4212 (open)

The triage note on #4212 says that Q4 and Q5 are open. The code takes the recommended option for each. These answers are open to the maintainer. A different answer changes only the parts named here.

- **Q5 (names from cache format 10 only?):** yes in this code (D1). A format-8 `.sc` gives no names and no note, and imports as before (`a_format_8_cache_reads_no_names_and_says_nothing`). To read more formats: one constant and one pin.
- **Q4 (which fixtures?):**
  - Most pins use containers that the tests build in code, with names of our own. This includes the alignment pin, the misfit pins and the hostile cases.
  - Three pins also read `testdata/models/hole_on_pocket_wall.sc`. That file is already in the repository and is already used by `hole_on_pocket_wall.rs`. The three pins are:
    - kernel `names::a_solidcraft_written_file_names_its_faces_in_record_order`;
    - geometry `source_faces::a_solidcraft_import_hands_out_the_record_of_its_own_facets`;
    - app `source_faces::a_solidcraft_import_lands_its_face_names`.
  - No pair made by SolidCraft from `examples/bracket.json` is used.
  - If the answer is "test-built containers only", remove those three pins. The other pins stay.

## Tests

**This branch is not built.** It was rebased onto `a721fd4dc` with no conflicts and not built locally, at the maintainer's request. Upstream changed four files that this PR also changes: `crates/app/src/commands/delete_entity.rs`, `crates/app/src/lib.rs`, `crates/app/src/schema.rs` and `crates/ui/src/state.rs`. The text merges clean. Nothing was compiled on the new base.

Pinning tests (16 new test functions):
- Kernel `solidcraft_import`:
  - `names::format_10_names_are_read_one_for_each_record_face`
  - `names::every_triangle_of_a_named_face_lies_on_that_faces_plane` (the alignment pin: a block that the test builds, each face named by its plane; a list shifted by one must fail)
  - `names::a_format_8_cache_reads_no_names_and_says_nothing`
  - `names::a_solidcraft_written_file_names_its_faces_in_record_order`
  - `names_misfit::names_that_do_not_fit_give_a_note_never_a_refusal` (18 misfits)
- Kernel `solidcraft_hostile`: `hostile_names_never_panic_or_refuse_the_import` (30 hostile values in the names record and its index, on a six-face block)
- Geometry `solidcraft`: `source_faces::{ranges_follow_the_runs_of_the_record_face_of_each_facet, a_face_past_the_names_gives_no_record, a_record_that_does_not_tile_is_told_apart, a_solidcraft_import_hands_out_the_record_of_its_own_facets}`
- App `import_solidcraft`: `source_faces::{a_solidcraft_import_lands_its_face_names, stl_obj_and_step_models_have_no_face_names, an_update_trades_the_names_on_undo_and_drops_them_unstated, a_repair_drops_the_names_and_undo_brings_them_back, a_deleted_model_comes_back_with_its_names, names_that_do_not_describe_the_facets_are_never_handed_out}`

Runs on the earlier base `773736856`, at the same code (Windows 11, debug, 2026-11-26). All 16 pinning tests passed.

| What | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --test solidcraft_import --test solidcraft_hostile` | ok: 13/13 and 4/4 |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-geometry --test solidcraft` | ok: 5/5 |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test import_solidcraft` | ok: 11 passed, 3 ignored (heavy-lane tests that were there before) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib` + the 82 app suites that `quick` maps to this diff | ok, after the asset re-run below |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` + the 14 UI suites that `quick` maps to this diff | ok: 14/14 suites; lib ok after the asset re-run and the intermittent test below |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-geometry` (all 39 targets) and `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --lib` | ok |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-{geometry,cl,gcode,tools,post,sim,motion,app,gpu,ui} --all-targets -- -D warnings`, then the same for `camcraft-kernel` | ok, both |

Readings: the hostile names run took 18.8 s (its bound is 120 s). The app `import_solidcraft` binary ran in 1.7 s.

Red steps on the earlier base, none from this PR:
- Seven app targets and one UI lib test read an old `assets/` folder. Our shared build folder was inside an older checkout, and `post::data_dir` looks two levels above the cargo profile folder. Run against this branch's own `assets/`, all pass: app lib 318/318, `after_op` 10/10, `explain_option` 4/4, `machine` 57/57, `per_op_files` 9/9, `posting` 17/17, `tormach_end_units` 8/8, UI `machines_pane`.
- `egui_app::tests::recent_door::an_empty_list_and_browse_open_todays_dialog` failed one time in a full UI lib run. It passed 8/8 three times alone. It expects an empty recent-files list.

Not exercised:
- Any build or test on the new base `a721fd4dc`.
- The full batch tier. `quick` becomes `batch` for a change under `crates/geometry/`. Batch builds each debug test binary first (about 169 GB for app on our machine), and that did not fit on the disk. In its place, we ran the mapped suites, all geometry suites and batch's clippy step above.
- The light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`).
- The wasm build of `geometry` and `app`.
- A pin for a body that the fallback mesher meshes. No fixture forces that path today (`machining_mesh_shortfalls.rs`). By reading only: the fallback also gives `tri_face` face by face.
- The three caller hooks have no test of their own. Each is one builder call, and clippy compiled them.
- `cargo fmt --check`: the new files are rustfmt-clean. Edits inside existing statements follow the style of each file.

On `a721fd4dc`, the `quick` map for this diff picks the app lib and 92 app suites, the UI lib and 14 UI suites, the kernel lib with `solidcraft_import` and `solidcraft_hostile`, and the geometry suite `solidcraft`. Because geometry changes, `quick` runs as `batch`.

## Overlap with open PRs

- #4235 (draft): it and this PR both add `mod` lines after `mod blend;` in `crates/kernel/tests/solidcraft_import.rs`. Keep both. Its test reads no names and no notes.
- #4066, #4270 and #4238 also change `crates/app/src/schema.rs` or `crates/ui/src/state.rs`. A trial merge of each with `a721fd4dc` and this PR is clean.

Changelog: Import: a SolidCraft `.sc` design (model cache format 10) keeps the SolidCraft name of each face beside the model's facets, in memory, for the face-pick work of #3915. A format-10 file whose names do not fit imports as before, with one note.

Effort: high

Fork synced at v0.27.0. The branch starts from upstream `main` `a721fd4dc`.
